load_obj_parse_mesh: parse an OBJ file into vertices, UVs, and face vertex/UV index arrays
load_krt_load_cameras: load camera calibration data including intrinsics, extrinsics, and distortion coefficients from a KRT file
check_path_validate: check if a file or directory path exists and exit with an error if it does not
create_Dataset_face_reconstruction: create a PyTorch Dataset for 3D face reconstruction that loads meshes, textures, photos, and camera parameters
getitem_Dataset_sample: get a sample from the Dataset containing aligned vertices, average texture, per-view texture, photo, view direction, and camera matrix
